title: Even or Odd
statement:
Given an integer N, determine whether it is even or odd.

Print "Even" if N is divisible by 2, otherwise print "Odd".
inputFormat: A single line containing one integer N.
outputFormat: Print "Even" if N is even, or "Odd" if N is odd.

examples.explanation: 4 is divisible by 2, so it is even.
7 is not divisible by 2, so it is odd.
